model_annotation: The graph shows the distribution of the target-side prediction probabilities during the MuST-C English-German training process. The x-axis is labeled with iteration counts, ranging from 0 to 30 in increments of 5, while the y-axis represents the Jensen-Shannon Divergence, spanning from 0 to 1.2 in increments of 0.2. Two lines are plotted on the graph: a blue line representing the probabilities before speech enhancement and an orange line representing the probabilities after speech enhancement. Both lines exhibit a similar trend, starting at around 1.1 on the y-axis and decreasing sharply to approximately 0.5 within the first 5 iterations. Beyond 5 iterations, the lines gradually decline, with the blue line stabilizing at around 0.52 and the orange line at around 0.48 by the 30th iteration.
